body:
WARRANT#169 shipped (pass_156): wired CalculateCorrelationRisk (D4) into OptimizePrecisionLotSize as a pure multiplicative discount, same shape and same composition point as the Kelly ceiling -- bounded [0.7,1.0], can only ever reduce sizing. 0 errors/0 warnings, marker-verified in the compiled copy before propagating (the process fix from the earlier lost-edit incident), deployed byte-identical everywhere.

I also looked seriously at wiring the bigger one -- GetCurrentThreshold's hour-of-day adjustment (Finding C/H-3) -- since it was the natural next target. Surveyed it properly: g_CurrentThreshold has 50+ write sites across nearly every calibration phase. Wiring the hour adjustment in safely means finding the exact live entry-decision comparison and confirming it doesn't double-apply against any of those 50+ writers -- that's genuinely its own dedicated pass with a hardening review, not something to fold in here. Left it named and scoped, not touched, rather than rush it.

Current shipped total this session: WARRANT#166 (GMT convention fix), #167 (Kelly floor seed), #168 (predictive system activation), #169 (correlation risk wiring) -- 4 real fixes, plus the tool-bug correction from before, all compiled clean and verified present before each propagation. Ledgers and capability register current.

Remaining real open items, unchanged: H-2/D4's last two members (IsBuffaloSetup, CalculateCompositeScore -- genuinely low value, correctly left dead), H-3 (UpdateAdaptiveGates -- now scoped as dedicated-pass-scale, not quick), and the full multi-agent "smith tungsten" roster sweep I flagged earlier as its own separate campaign.
